answer_4.quote: We ask annotators to label each stereotype candidate tuple (id, attr) based on their awareness of a commonly‑held opinion about the target identity group … Each candidate was annotated by 3 annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators select one of the following labels: Stereotypical (S), Non‑Stereotypical (N), Unsure (U). For offensiveness, annotators rate the attribute on a Likert scale from Not offensive (‑1) to Extremely Offensive (+4).
